title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Sterile Supply Percentage
content:
The sterile supply percentage applied to the revenue code 0272 supply charges of an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is 0.25 (25%) when a Commercial HMO Claim is for an Observation Stay Account, 0.33 (33%) when a Commercial PPO Claim is for an Observation Stay Account, and otherwise the payer class's expected allowed percentage of charges.

Input, judgement, output (hypothetical sterile supply charges of 200.00):
- Commercial HMO Claim, Observation Stay Account → 50.00.
- Commercial PPO Claim, Observation Stay Account → 66.00.
- Commercial PPO Claim, Emergency Department Visit Account → the expected allowed percentage of 200.00.
